data.name: YXEIX
data.notes:
YXEIX Route Servers offer secure route filtering using IRR data and RPKI ROA.

For prefixes to pass validation on the YXEIX route servers, peers must maintain IRR route objects, RPKI ROAs, and/or ARIN WHOIS OriginAS entries. 

Peers with downstream networks must also maintain IRR as-set objects, and place the as-set name in the peeringdb.com "IRR Record" field.

Please contact the YXEIX (Info@YXEIX.com) if you require assistance or would like more details about our filtering platform. 

Happy Peering!

![YXEIX][logo]

[logo]: https://yxeix.ca/img/YXEIX_Logo.png "Saskatoon Internet Exchange"

data.name: STLIX
data.notes:
### How to participate?
Please visit http://stlix.net and click the application up top or email peering@stlix.net to connect. 

1/10/40/100 Gb ports available in all sites 

### Max Prefix Settings
Recommended limits to allow for future growth  
IPv4: 120000  
IPv6: 50000  

### Route Server Communities:
0:$peerasn to exclude your routes to $peerasn
46389:$peerasn to include your routes to $peerasn
0:46389 to exclude your routes from all peers

### Official STLIX Extensions:
Kansas City via KCIX - http://kcix.net  
https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/249

Houston via HOUIX - http://houix.net
https://www.peeringdb.com/ix/2835

### Mailing List:
Please email info@stlix.net if you wish to be subscribed to the STLIX members mailing list.
